question: What digital photos must an Express Entry applicant provide?

claims.text: Digital photos meeting IRCC's permanent resident card photo specifications must be provided for Express Entry applications.
claims.quote: Digital photos meeting [IRCC’s permanent resident card photo specifications (PDF, 614.24 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/information/applications/guides/pdf/5445eb-e.pdf) must be provided.

basis: The applicant submitted a digital photo document (1e0002adc5e8fd5d850aea9eb4f602fe.pdf) in the digital_photo slot for an Express Entry e-APR.
prose: For an Express Entry application, digital photos meeting IRCC's permanent resident card photo specifications must be provided.
